verdict.rationale: Autumn is a billing, metering and entitlements SaaS that handles customer data, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it uses that data for AI training. The evidence pack has no training opt-out, data-use policy or privacy commitment. Self-hosting (bun dev) is a deployment option, not a documented control over model training, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
